## A. Program-order authority

Stable owner decision: `SCI-FRUIT-OD-PROGRAM-ORDER-2026-09-06`.

SCI-FRUIT Stage B may author the generic conditional scientific core before
an exact numerical FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD has been owner-approved or numerically
qualified. This changes only the ordinary authorship sequence. It permits
scientific roles, typed spaces/operator signatures, conditional equations,
response/uncertainty consequences under explicit premises, state/iteration/
continuation/termination/terminal meanings, required method-record contents,
typed unavailable states and falsifiable conditional predictions.

It authorizes no numerical parent, model, projector, residual or rejoin
operator, recurrence/update, grouping, support behavior, learning schedule,
convergence threshold, iteration limit, terminal selector or numerical
uncertainty. It establishes no implementation conformity, validation or
production permission. Exact packet approval is still required before any
author is launched; this candidate is not a launch instruction.

## B. Conditional scientific-composition authority

Stable owner decision: `SCI-FRUIT-OD-CONDITIONAL-COMPOSITION-2026-09-06`.

The core may derive consequences of the role order: remove the declared model

[RESPONSE_AND_UNCERTAINTY_FAMILIES.md](RESPONSE_AND_UNCERTAINTY_FAMILIES.md).

## C. Numerical-method authority

`FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD v0.1` is the required-record authority family.
Every numerical method must have its own exact
`FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD/<method-name>@<revision>` identity and owner approval.
Creating the family record approves no method-specific identity. Numerical
availability remains `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`.

The [required record](FRUIT_FEEDBACK_METHOD_REQUIRED_RECORD.md) must eventually
bind the actual operators, recurrence, grouping, support, learning, stopping,
terminal selection and failure behavior, with every other required field.
Approval of A or B does not imply C. The core may be authored and later frozen
while C, numerical parents/model construction/stopping/selection/response/
covariance and downstream named-use profiles remain unavailable. Stage B
must derive conditional consequences and typed unavailability, not fill a
missing field with familiar practice, current software or a plausible default.

The r0.4 micro-repair requires three distinct candidate/accepted/applied models,
with the applied model in the composition; explicit acceptance-to-application
transformations; complete linearity of A_k, Pi_k and B_k before the D_k
operator and its linear model-response/covariance formulas; and method rules
distinct from realized state generations. It preserves route-conditional parent
quantities and the exact seven response roles in the Scope Brief and response
table. A numerical method may add requirements but may not waive the core's
universal minimum bundle or hard claim dependencies. No online adaptive filter
or other numerical estimator is introduced by response terminology.

## Later author outputs and review

One canonical LaTeX authority supplies the scientist-facing rationale and
engineering-facing conformance view. Both use the same six modules:
`src/common/notation.tex`, `definitions.tex`, `equations.tex`,
`assumptions.tex`, `requirements.tex` and `edge_cases.tex` under that common
directory. Use stable requirement/prediction IDs, a decision log, owner ledger
and the three-column requirement/scientist-facing-source/engineering-
interpretation crosswalk. Engineering requirements add no independent science.

The rationale opens with a compact input/output/equation/source/status block,
leads with physical meaning, ordinarily keeps its main narrative to eight to
twelve pages, and puts bookkeeping in appendices or the engineering view.
Contract version v and document revision r are distinct. Preserve validity,
uncertainty, assumptions, all required predictions and unavailable claims.
Approved facts, known-but-unsupplied facts, open decisions, unassessed
implementation and unperformed validation remain distinct.

Compile and check both views, render with Poppler and inspect every page before
presenting those later documents as complete. This permits document checks,
not scientific experiments. The inherited three-substantive-round review
limit, independent consistency review and separate owner freeze remain.

The fresh author reads only author-permitted files in the approved manifest
and later explicit owner answers. File links and source identities do not
grant access to unlisted originals. Internal recovery, code, schemas,
configuration/defaults, tests, audits/repairs, reductions, generated numerical
products, performance/validation/production records, Unity and web sources
are excluded. Return a precise unresolved scientific premise to the owner;
do not infer an algorithm from missing information.
